newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Mexico's Ortiz says inflation target feasible.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ortiz says inflation target feasible.

text.p: Mexican Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz said on Friday the government's 15 percent inflation target for this year was realistic.
"I think it is feasible," he told Reuters Financial Television.
Private forecasts predict a slightly higher rate.
Ortiz said the slightly higher inflation figure in December at 3.2 percent month-on-month from November's 1.52 percent was a one-off.
"Inflation ticked up in December...that was a once-and-for-all effect because of some price adjustments. I think generally inflation will be substantially lower from that of December," he said.
He predicted that February's level would be easily below two percent.
